scenarios.scenario: Insight — Inspect Distrib property across projects in signing build

rubricScores.criterion: Found the Distrib property value for the DataSources project
Checked whether other projects (Common, StorageLibrary) use the same Distrib path
Identified that multiple projects point to the same shared output folder (e.g. the ConfigurationLinterService path)
Explained how this shared folder causes the signing conflict — signtool encounters files owned by other projects

scenarios.reasoning: The agent efficiently found the Distrib value for DataSources and identified the signing error, but missed the core insight the question was driving at: that multiple projects share the same output directory (the ConfigurationLinterService Distrib path), which causes the signing conflict. When it couldn't find properties for the other projects in the binlog, it gave up rather than investigating further. Its alternative explanation (double-write causing signing failure) was speculative and missed the mark. The execution was efficient (11 tool calls, no errors) but the analysis was incomplete on the most important points.
